fidelity_misses: Tagline set as 'COFFEE BY THE HARBOR' (all caps) in every lockup; brief gives 'Coffee by the harbor'

defects.what: Lower wave stroke runs past the 64x64 viewBox and is cut off flat along the bottom edge of the standalone mark files
Wordmark and tagline are in generic default-looking serif/sans faces (DejaVu-like); no considered type choice or pairing
The two waves turn into a grey checker of half-tone pixels; only the amber drop reads
Opaque cream square background; looks like a pale tile in dark browser tabs
Drop tip curls off to the right into a hairline point that disappears at small sizes
Large dead band between the lockups and the mark rows; the mark/mark-mono pair is stranded at bottom-left

HTCU.craft_notes: Drop over twin waves with short rays: clear lamp-and-water idea and bold enough, but it looks like a stock 'sunset/water' icon. The type is the weak point: plain default serif bold with wide-tracked default sans. The colour use is disciplined (amber/navy, cream reverse). The sheet is complete and clearly labelled but loosely spaced. The standalone mark SVGs are clipped at the bottom.
HTCU.revision_notes: Both lockups and the sheet now read 'Tidewick & Co.' and 'COFFEE · BAKERY · HARBOR' with real middle dots. Lockup viewBoxes are widened with the same height, and the mark and type scale are unchanged. Mark, favicon and app icon carry no text and are unchanged (only the SVG titles changed). On the sheet the horizontal lockup is scaled down to fit, which is a necessary reflow, not drift. The all-caps tagline carries over from r1.

fidelity_misses: Tagline set as 'COFFEE BY THE HARBOR' (all caps) in every lockup; brief gives 'Coffee by the harbor'

defects.what: Two beam wedges either side of a central flame above a wavy band read as a face (eyes, nose, wobbly mouth) or a bow tie; the lighthouse-light idea is weak
The left flame lobe ends in an abrupt flat-cut point and the inner notch looks like a cut rather than a drawn flame
Amber shapes pick up brown fringe pixels against navy; at 16 px it reads as an orange blob in a disc rather than a clear symbol
Bottom-right quadrant is empty below the stacked lockup (dead band); the app icon appears only on the cream half
Item labels sit at x=60 while the lockup art starts at x=90; captions don't align to the artwork

VTCH.craft_notes: A strong, characterful soft-serif wordmark with a tracked sans tagline, which suits a warm coastal café. The navy badge holds together as a unit and reverses well to an amber disc on navy. The symbol inside is the problem: wedge beams plus flame plus a single wave read as a face. The sheet is tidy at the top and empty at the bottom right. All the vectors are clean.
VTCH.revision_notes: Horizontal and stacked lockups and both halves of the sheet updated to 'Tidewick & Co.' / 'COFFEE · BAKERY · HARBOR' with proper middle dots. The '&' and 'Co.' are set in the same face. Lockup viewBoxes are widened, and the native mark size is unchanged. Mark, mono mark, favicon and app icon are byte-identical, which is correct because they carry no text. The sheet is reflowed with a smaller stacked lockup to fit the longer name; there is no unrequested drift. The all-caps tagline carries over from r1.

pairwise_round1.why: VTCH's considered serif wordmark and self-contained badge look like a finished identity, while HTCU uses default-looking type and ships a mark SVG clipped at the bottom, even though VTCH's symbol risks reading as a face.
